mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag.rag_kp_alias (alias_id, tenant_id, kp_id, alias_text) VALUES (#{aliasId}::uuid, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{kpId}::uuid, #{aliasText}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, kp_id, alias_text) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT alias_text FROM rag.rag_kp_alias WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND kp_id = #{kpId}::uuid ORDER BY created_at, alias_text

SELECT kp_id::text, subject, grade, canonical_name, COALESCE(array_length(aliases, 1), 0) AS alias_count, COALESCE(array_length(prerequisites, 1), 0) AS prereq_count FROM rag.rag_knowledge_point WHERE tenant_id IN (${tenantLiteral}, rag_global_tenant_id()) AND (#{keyword}::text IS NULL OR canonical_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword}::text || '%') ORDER BY subject, grade, canonical_name LIMIT #{limit}
